retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s album cover aesthetic featuring a high-contrast close-up portrait with bold, tightly-packed sans-serif typography justified to the left.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a warm-toned, soft-focus portrait of a person with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle, positioned slightly off-center. The left side is dominated by large, bold, white sans-serif text with extremely tight letter and line spacing, creating a block-like typographic texture against the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Text block anchored to the left vertical axis
Subject's gaze directed toward the viewer
Contrast between soft photographic textures and sharp typographic edges
Warm skin tones against a cool-toned, out-of-focus background
coreInvariants: Soft-focus photographic style with visible grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large-scale title text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title on the left, moves right to the subject's face, then down to the smaller tracklist text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject and dense typographic blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm flesh tones and deep black hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and grey background tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in text; moderate saturation in the portrait with soft, diffused lighting.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to naturalistic skin tones and primary white/black

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely tight tracking causing letters to nearly touch
Reduced leading for a compact vertical block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in varying weights and scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque aesthetic and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, soft-focus 1960s style portrait of a person with a bouffant hairstyle, wearing a white textured sweater, positioned on the right side of the frame with a muted blue-grey background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold white grotesque sans-serif text to the left side. Use extremely tight tracking and leading. The main title should be large at the top left, followed by a smaller list of text below it, all left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking tight enough that letters almost touch?
Is the portrait soft-focus with a vintage grain?

postGenerationChecks: Verify text does not obscure the subject's eyes
Check for consistent grain across image and text
Ensure the white text is legible against the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait on right + Dense Grotesque block on left + Soft 60s Grain = Mid-Century Soul Aesthetic
